content.name: Jasmine Tran
content.title: Junior Accountant
content.summary: BCom accounting graduate enrolled in the CPA Professional Education Program, with two years in property management accounting and a co-op term in oilfield services. Handles payables, bank reconciliations and GST for 38 residential buildings, and cleared a 900-invoice backlog in her first quarter.

experience.title: Junior Accountant
bullets: Reconcile 52 operating and trust bank accounts monthly for 38 residential buildings, closing each within five business days.
Cleared a backlog of 900 unpaid vendor invoices in Yardi within ten weeks by setting up approval routing with site managers.
Prepare quarterly GST returns and track input tax credits, flagging $14,000 in credits that had not been claimed.
Draft owner statements and budget-versus-actual reports for six condominium boards.

experience.title: Accounting Co-op Student
bullets: Matched 2,300 field tickets to purchase orders and invoices, cutting the unbilled work list by a third.
Built an Excel template for monthly prepaid insurance and lease amortization that the controller still uses.
Supported the year-end audit by pulling samples and preparing lead sheets for fixed assets.

education.school: University of Calgary, Haskayne School of Business

achievements.title: Invoice backlog cleared
achievements.detail: Brought 900 overdue invoices to zero within ten weeks of starting at Bowmont.

achievements.title: Case competition finalist
achievements.detail: Top three of 20 teams at the Haskayne accounting case competition, 2023.
